# OnStage Academy

> OnStage Academy is a destination management company (DMC) based in Orlando, Florida. It plans and operates meetings, incentive trips, sports programs and student travel for groups across the entire United States. It is the destination management arm of Aloha of America, an event management company with 14 years of experience. Service is available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

## Key facts
- Type: Destination management company (DMC)
- Headquarters: 6400 Time Square Ave, Unit 10c, Orlando, FL 32835, USA
- Coverage: all of the United States
- Languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish
- Contact: info@onstageacademy.com, +1 (407) 307-6740
- Founders: Annie Marie Bittencourt (CEO & Co-Founder), Jessica Nardulli (Co-Founder & Managing Partner)
- Parent company: Aloha of America

## Programs
- Professional Development: conferences, trainings and leadership programs
- Incentive Programs: reward trips for teams and partners
- Sporting Programs: training camps, tournaments and sports immersions
- Youth Educational Programs: student travel combining learning, culture and fun
- Custom Programs: designed from scratch

## Services
Hotel coordination (group rates, room blocks, contracting); events (venues, F&B, entertainment, decor); transportation (vans, SUVs, minibuses, coaches, double-deckers, limousines, VIP transfers); tours & activities (theme parks, historic tours, team building, technical visits); logistics; meeting services (speakers, simultaneous interpretation, AV, staffing).
